events.title: Red Rabbits De-Escalation training
events.venue: Wooden Shoe Books, 704 South St, Philadelphia, PA 19147
events.description: Join the Red Rabbis for their De-Escalation 101 training to learn some basics surrounding de-escalation practices that can be used towards greater community care int he streets or on the ground.  We will discuss ways to keep ourselves grounded, and practice co-regulation through tension and conflicts.  Great for organizers interested in practicing community safety/care in addition to public workers.  Every second Thursday of the month at the Shoe.  Masks required and provided!
